Facts: Chen used his position as head of Wuhan office of Xiamen travel agency (Hubei Xiazhuo International Travel Agency) to misappropriate (挪用) travel group fees paid by other travel agencies to Xiazhuo, total 188,748 yuan, used for personal consumption and car loan repayment. He later returned all money and got forgiveness. This is classic "挪用公款" (misappropriation of public funds) but here it's misappropriation of funds belonging to the travel agency (company). In Chinese criminal law, "挪用公款" refers to misappropriation of public funds by state employees. For private funds, the charge is "侵占" (appropriation) or "挪用公款" sometimes used for misappropriation of public funds. However in examples, they used "挪用公款" for cases where employee of unit misappropriated unit's funds (e.g., 王3某 case: school cashier misappropriated public funds). That was labeled "挪用公款". So we should label "挪用公款". Also maybe "侵占"? The list includes "侵占". In examples, they used "挪用公款" for school cashier case. So we choose "挪用公款". No other crimes. So final answer: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa>.
